response.subject: nuketown-2025

rows.finding: In r1c1-r1c2 the reference barrel-vault garage wing and sweeping butterfly roof are missing and replaced by a flat slab box, disagreeing in structure not grade.
rows.referenceEvidence: center-right reference shows cream garage box with three dark barrel vaults and pale butterfly roof sweep with solar panels over orange upper wall
rows.captureEvidence: center capture r1c1-r1c2 shows flat dark slab rim on blue box with no vaults and no roof sweep
rows.boundedCorrection: Add three barrel-vault garage-wing volumes over garage end using existing procedural TSL construction only, change nothing else.

rows.finding: In r1c0-r1c1 the exterior stair run to deck height and circular patio diameter ratio disagrees, stair reads short steep and floating versus long grounded flight to patio.
rows.referenceEvidence: left-center reference shows long wooden stair from railed upper deck down to large circular concrete patio at lawn
rows.captureEvidence: center capture shows short floating white treads with no stringer landing on small stacked square plinth, no circular patio
rows.boundedCorrection: Extend exterior stair run to grade and enlarge landing to circular-patio proportion in code-built geometry only, change nothing else.

rows.finding: In r1c1 the upper wall reads as strongly striped cladding and in r2c0-r2c1 lawn reads as coarse tufts, versus smooth show-home render and mown lawn at same distance.
rows.referenceEvidence: reference upper wall reads as smooth terracotta band and lawn reads as flat mown green with stepping stones
rows.captureEvidence: capture blue wall shows heavy horizontal siding lines and lawn shows large isolated grass sprites on flat ground
rows.boundedCorrection: Reduce wall siding bump scale to smooth painted-panel read using existing procedural material, change no hues and nothing else.

rows.finding: In r0c1-r2c1 the brightest-plane order and contact shadow disagree, reference roof is brightest with soft under-deck shadow while capture wall is dark with harsh diagonal lawn split.
rows.referenceEvidence: reference brightest plane is pale roof sweep with gentle shadow in recessed undercroft and even lawn value
rows.captureEvidence: capture house side in deep shadow in r1c1 with diagonal hard shadow splitting lawn in r2c1 and flat overcast sky in r0c1
rows.boundedCorrection: Raise key-light elevation to make roof plane brightest and soften lawn shadow split with no colour-grade change, change nothing else.
